authority: Explicit user instruction: persistent production graph-update stop
scope: Production source/native graph refresh, staging, publish/resume, registration, imports, migrations and unattended writer launches
preserve: Existing graph/CT, operational SQLite registry, captures, pending journals, checkpoints and evidence
allowed: SQLite-only reconstruction issuance/admission, immutable evidence reading and isolated offline fixture tests
reopen: Only after a new explicit user instruction and reviewed code/policy change; no environment or command-line bypass
